fuentes: Fuentes, the tall gypsy, was standing holding a pair of banderillos, holding them together, slim, red sticks, fish-hook points out.
“Tell him to drop the next pair on the right,” he said to the kid who started to run out to Fuentes with the new banderillos.
Leaning back, inciting the bull with the banderillos, Fuentes jumped, both feet off the ground.
Fuentes twitched the two banderillos and the light on the steel points caught the bull’s eye.
Fuentes stood watching, his cape held against his body, tall, in repose, watching lazy-eyed.
Fuentes came down on his toes, arms straight out, whole body arching forward, and drove the shafts straight down as he swung his body clear of the right horn.
